primary_intent: Understand the current Steam achievement list and plan an efficient cleanup order
source_title: How to Fish Global Achievements
supported_key_facts: Steam lists 28 achievements for How to Fish as checked on August 23, 2026. The efficient order is: finish the story normally, collect easy combat and food actions during that run, use post-story travel for creature and Drip cleanup, then attempt the dedicated challenges. Do not combine the one-hour Bean run with the bare-hands Handyman finale; those goals pull preparation in opposite directions and are safer as separate saves or attempts.

primary_intent: Troubleshoot a How to Fish Steam achievement that did not unlock
source_title: How to Fish Patch 1.0.4
supported_key_facts: Update How to Fish to the current Steam version before repeating the achievement condition. Restart Steam and the game, then read the achievement’s exact current wording on Steam. Patch 1.0.4 fixed the final-boss bare-hands result for everyone, and patch 1.0.5 fixed the all-Drip trigger that previously needed one extra find. For story goals, finish the NPC return step. For personal actions in co-op, perform the condition on your own account. Preserve the save before repeating a long run.

primary_intent: Plan efficient attempts for the hardest and rarest How to Fish achievements
source_title: How to Fish Global Achievements
supported_key_facts: Separate the long collection goals from the skill and speed attempts. Use a completed save to sweep every normal creature for Collector and every Drip variant for Fishipedia. Attempt Easy on an early boss with endgame damage. Run Handyman as a dedicated final-boss attempt using only bare hands, and run Bean on another focused route that finishes within one hour. Do not combine Bean with Handyman: one rewards route speed while the other deliberately removes your strongest damage tools.

primary_intent: Unlock every achievement tied directly to the main story and island quests
source_title: How to Fish Global Achievements
supported_key_facts: The story-linked Steam goals follow the same island chain: Who stole my beer at the lighthouse, Dinnertime in the forest, Grillmaster and Vacation around the desert route, Terrorizing bird on the rocky island, Deadliest catch during the military or volcano sequence, and We are so back after the ending. Complete the NPC hand-in after each encounter. The final achievement requires returning the last drop, receiving the RHIB key, and starting that boat—not only killing the boss.

primary_intent: Identify the story boss order and choose the right detailed boss guide
source_title: Complete How to Fish game walkthrough
supported_key_facts: The verified story order is Spider Crab, Giant Piranha, Pufferfish, the terrorizing bird encounter, and the mutated whale finale. Each fight begins through an island quest rather than a free-roaming spawn. Prepare before consuming the special bait, watch the boss escape or pressure pattern, and recover the distinctive drop. Killing a boss rarely completes progression on its own; the trophy normally has to return to the NPC who gave the request.

primary_intent: Defeat Giant Piranha and finish the forest island quest
source_title: Complete How to Fish game walkthrough
supported_key_facts: Collect three ground leeches and give them to the forest lady for the Giant Piranha bait. Bring a shotgun for the main target, keep a melee option for the small piranhas it produces, and carry cooked fish for recovery. The boss does not repeat Spider Crab’s long self-stun, so keep moving while applying close-range damage. Clear adds before they surround you, then pick up the distinct piranha drop and return it to the lady.

primary_intent: Defeat the final mutated whale boss and trigger the ending
source_title: Complete How to Fish game walkthrough
supported_key_facts: Prepare a fully attached assault rifle and far more cooked healing than the regular whale alone requires. Complete the scientist’s bait request, defeat the first whale, carry it up the plank route, and throw it into the volcano. Against the mutated whale, keep moving through rolls, sky stomps, lava pools, and later meteor pressure; shoot only while your escape lane is clear and heal after each hit. Return the final drop to the scientist, then start the RHIB.

primary_intent: Defeat the Island 3 Pufferfish boss and continue progression
source_title: Complete How to Fish game walkthrough
supported_key_facts: Give the desert tourist a catch marked as endangered to receive the Carrot boss bait. Unlock the grill first, carry cooked fish, and fight in the most open part of the island. When Pufferfish rolls, move sideways out of its line, then shoot during the gap before the next approach. As the fight advances, avoid the purple poison trail and widen your spacing as the target grows. Recover its unique drop and return it to the tourist.

primary_intent: Defeat Spider Crab and complete the lighthouse boss hand-in
source_title: Complete How to Fish game walkthrough
supported_key_facts: Complete the lighthouse keeper’s beer interaction, equip the returned Empty Beer Can as bait, and summon Spider Crab only after sharpening an early melee weapon. Keep enough space to see its approach. Let it commit to a charge, sidestep rather than backing straight away, then strike during the short self-stun after it misses. Repeat without wandering too far, pick up the unique drop, and return it to the keeper for the boat key.

primary_intent: Defeat the large bird story boss on Island 4 and unlock the volcano
source_title: Complete How to Fish game walkthrough
supported_key_facts: Activate the rocky island’s bird quest, use the Professional Boss Lure to catch Tuna, defeat that mini-boss, and place the Tuna body on open ground. When the large bird arrives, move under a building roof, track its approach, and use an Uzi or another accurate ranged weapon after each pass or ranged attack. Avoid standing in the open or relying on a short-range shotgun. Recover the bird’s distinct head or trophy and return it for volcano coordinates.

primary_intent: Catch and defeat the Tuna mini-boss without losing the bird bait
source_title: Complete How to Fish game walkthrough
supported_key_facts: To catch and beat the Tuna boss, activate the Island 4 bird request, equip the Professional Boss Lure, and cast. Dodge across its jumping line, attack after it lands, then keep the body instead of selling or cooking it; placing it near cover starts the bird encounter.

primary_intent: Invert horizontal or vertical camera controls in How to Fish
source_title: How to Fish Patch 1.0.11
supported_key_facts: Install the current update, then set X- and Y-axis camera inversion separately. Patch 1.0.11 also adds an option to use toggle for aiming, but that changes whether aim stays active after an input; it does not replace camera-axis inversion. Change one setting at a time, test in a safe area, and temporarily disable external remapping if the result is inconsistent.

primary_intent: Troubleshoot missing leech pickups during the Island 2 quest
source_title: How to Fish Full Island and Boss Progression Walkthrough
supported_key_facts: First confirm the forest lady’s request is active and that you are searching ground pickups, not fishing for leeches. Make one slow island sweep while watching the interaction prompt and the live three-leech counter. If the counter remains short after a complete sweep, leave the pickups untouched in future attempts, return to the main menu, reload the same session once, and check again. No reliable respawn interval or destructive save fix was verified for version 1.0.5.

primary_intent: Fix or safely diagnose a black screen when joining How to Fish multiplayer
source_title: How to Fish Patch 1.0.11
supported_key_facts: Install the current update on every player’s machine before using workarounds. Patch 1.0.4 addressed black and gray screens with qualified wording; Patch 1.0.11 separately says it hopefully fixed an inventory bug on join that made players invisible. Restart Steam, test one host and one joiner in a fresh private lobby, and record whether the symptom is a blank screen, an invisible player, or a red relay status instead of treating them as one bug.

primary_intent: Create an invite-only How to Fish lobby and troubleshoot joining
source_title: How to Fish Patch 1.0.5
supported_key_facts: Update to 1.0.5, choose the private or invite-only option while creating the session, then invite friends through the supported Steam flow. A private lobby cannot be browsed like a public one; joining depends on the invite. Patch 1.0.5 also allows changing session type in server settings while in-game, but the official note says that change requires a restart. If an invite appears ineffective, restart the session after changing type and test with one joiner first.

primary_intent: Find a safe first troubleshooting route for current How to Fish issues
source_title: How to Fish Patch 1.0.11
supported_key_facts: Update How to Fish before trying launch-week workarounds. Patch 1.0.11 adds pre-load corruption checks, save backups, new control options, and a qualified inventory-on-join invisibility fix. It does not publish a manual backup-restore path or guarantee that every older crash is resolved. Reproduce the problem once, separate solo from host or joiner behavior, preserve saves, and change one reversible variable at a time.

primary_intent: Safely diagnose a corrupted save or weapon equip crash in How to Fish
source_title: How to Fish Patch 1.0.11
supported_key_facts: Patch 1.0.11 says save files are always checked for corruption before loading and now have backups in case they become corrupt. The announcement does not publish backup filenames, retention, or a manual restore procedure, and it does not say every older damaged save or weapon-equip crash is repaired. Update first, stop repeating the failing action, preserve the affected data, and distinguish game-file verification from save recovery.

primary_intent: Diagnose a red Steam relay connection failure in How to Fish multiplayer
source_title: How to Fish Patch 1.0.9
supported_key_facts: Patch 1.0.9 added a red Steam relay status to show that a relay connection failed and asked affected players to report it. The indicator is diagnostic; the patch note does not tell players to open ports, disable firewalls, or change router security. Update every player, compare solo with one fresh private lobby, record host and joiner roles plus the red status timing, then report the repeatable case through an official developer channel.

primary_intent: Start How to Fish and reach the first boss without losing progression items
source_title: How to Fish on Steam
supported_key_facts: Start at the lighthouse, talk to the keeper, use easy catches to build a small cash buffer, and buy only what advances the current job. Your first real gate is the beer-thief quest and Spider Crab. Prepare a sharpened melee weapon before using the Empty Beer Can bait, keep the dropped boss item, return it to the keeper, then take the boat keys and obtain the radar before sailing away.

primary_intent: Understand the official How to Fish difficulty settings and choose a mode
source_title: How to Fish Patch 1.0.9
supported_key_facts: Patch 1.0.9 added three modes. Easy gives creatures 25% less health and makes them deal 50% less damage. Normal keeps the balance from before the patch. Hard gives creatures 25% more health and makes them deal 25% more damage. The announcement does not say that difficulty changes quests, rewards, achievements, prices, saves, or co-op matching, so those effects should be treated as unknown rather than assumed.

primary_intent: Get the lighthouse boat keys and unlock travel to the forest island
source_title: How to Fish Patch 1.0.5
supported_key_facts: To get the boat keys, finish the lighthouse keeper’s beer request, use the Empty Beer Can to summon Spider Crab, collect the boss drop, and return it. Then take the radar and follow the awarded coordinates to the forest island. Patch 1.0.5 fixed unintended travel to locked islands, so do not rely on launch-day shortcut videos.

primary_intent: Continue progression immediately after defeating the Pufferfish boss
source_title: Complete How to Fish game walkthrough
supported_key_facts: Pick up the distinct item Pufferfish leaves and take it back to the tourist on the desert island. Finish the conversation until the next coordinates are awarded; the boss kill alone does not update travel. Before leaving, restock cooked healing items, check the boat’s engine and radar setup, and keep one open inventory slot. Follow the new route to the rocky fourth island, speak to its shop or quest NPC, and prepare for a Tuna-to-bird encounter chain.

primary_intent: Complete the rocky island Tuna and terrorizing bird progression chain
source_title: Complete How to Fish game walkthrough
supported_key_facts: Speak to the rocky island’s quest NPC about the large bird, then obtain the Professional Boss Lure and use it to catch Tuna. Defeat the Tuna as a mini-boss, keep the body, and place it on open ground as bait for the aerial encounter. Fight the terrorizing bird from building cover with a ranged weapon, collect the head or distinct trophy after the kill, and return it to the NPC to receive the volcano coordinates.

primary_intent: Understand the island order and what unlocks every next destination
source_title: How to Fish on Steam
supported_key_facts: How to Fish currently progresses through five main locations: the lighthouse starting island, a forest island, a desert island, a rocky island, and the volcano. The game often labels progression by coordinates and quest rewards rather than giving every island a strong proper name. Use the active objective and radar route as your source of truth: every new destination follows a local quest, a boss or special creature, and a required return item.

primary_intent: Reach the third island, beat its quest chain, and unlock Island 4
source_title: Complete How to Fish game walkthrough
supported_key_facts: To get to the third island, finish the forest island’s Giant Piranha hand-in and follow the new coordinates to the desert. On Island 3, complete the grill-side request, then give the tourist a fish the game marks as endangered to receive the Carrot. Use that bait to summon and beat Pufferfish, preserve its distinct drop, and return it to the tourist to unlock Island 4.

primary_intent: Find the three leeches and start the Giant Piranha quest on Island 2
source_title: Complete How to Fish game walkthrough
supported_key_facts: Speak to the lady by the lake on the forest island, then search the island floor for three leech pickups. They are collected from the ground, not caught with a fishing rod, and tall grass can make the small model harder to see than the pickup prompt. Give all three to the quest giver to receive the Giant Piranha bait. Equip that returned bait on your rod, summon the boss, and preserve its distinct drop for the return hand-in.

primary_intent: Complete the volcano route and finish the main story after the final boss
source_title: Complete How to Fish game walkthrough
supported_key_facts: At the volcano, speak to the scientist in protective gear and give him five local catches using the Scientific Lure route. Take the resulting whale bait, stock a strong rifle and cooked healing items, then defeat the regular whale. Carry that whale up the intended plank path and throw it into the volcano to start the harder mutated whale fight. After the final kill, return its distinct drop to the scientist, take the RHIB key, and start the RHIB for the ending.

primary_intent: Choose the most useful early weapon and boat upgrades without wasting money
source_title: Complete How to Fish game walkthrough
supported_key_facts: Spend early money on one sharpened melee weapon, the story-required boat and radar path, and then a shotgun when the forest island makes firearms practical. Do not buy every lure, side weapon, or attachment as soon as it appears. The opening only needs enough damage for Spider Crab; Island 2 rewards a reliable gun that remains useful across several encounters. Upgrade for the next verified gate, keep a healing and bait budget, and delay optional collection tools until progression is secure.

primary_intent: Unlock the grill and cook fish for healing, value, and achievements
source_title: How to Fish Patch 1.0.11
supported_key_facts: On the desert island, complete the creature request beside the grill and speak to that NPC to receive the lighter or start access. Place ordinary catches on the grill and remove them at the cooked state; cooked fish can support healing and, in launch walkthrough evidence, improves sale value. Patch 1.0.11 specifically fixes Drip Parrotfish not being cooked. Practice with cheap catches before using rare or quest-related items.

primary_intent: Understand which lures are bought and which boss bait comes from quests
source_title: Complete How to Fish game walkthrough
supported_key_facts: Normal lure tiers catch the regular creatures available around an island. Purchasable boss lures are mainly for optional mini-bosses and collection or achievement work. Story bosses use special bait produced by local quests: the Empty Beer Can, converted leeches, Carrot, Tuna prepared through a Professional Boss Lure, and the scientist’s whale bait. Read the active objective before casting, equip the exact returned item on the rod, and prepare the fight before consuming any limited bait.

primary_intent: Earn money efficiently for weapons, boat upgrades, lures, and healing
source_title: How to Fish Patch 1.0.11
supported_key_facts: The safe money loop is catch creatures you can kill consistently, add deliberate killscore bonuses, cook when the grill is available, and sell in regular batches. Patch 1.0.11 requires an item to have been held once before it can be sold, so pick up an unrecognized catch before treating the shop as broken. New islands raise combat risk, and gambling remains entertainment rather than dependable progression income.

primary_intent: Obtain the radar and use it to navigate to unlocked islands
source_title: Complete How to Fish game walkthrough
supported_key_facts: Finish the lighthouse keeper’s Spider Crab quest and secure boat access, then obtain the radar from the keeper before sailing. The radar works with coordinates awarded by completed island quests; it does not unlock destinations on its own. Early on, carry or equip it as required to read the route. A later boat upgrade lets the radar remain in a fixed position on the boat, which makes navigation easier but does not replace any boss trophy or NPC hand-in.

primary_intent: Choose weapons that fit each island and boss stage
source_title: How to Fish Patch 1.0.11
supported_key_facts: Use one sharpened melee weapon for the lighthouse and Spider Crab, then add a shotgun and later an accurate ranged option for the bird and volcano. Patch 1.0.11 removes Iron Sight as a purchase, prevents downgrading a Suppressor to a Compensator, and marks dropped weapons with orange dots. Upgrade a proven weapon before buying overlapping ones, and do not rely on an older shop guide for those two attachment actions.

primary_intent: Complete the lighthouse opening and leave the first island
source_title: Complete How to Fish game walkthrough
supported_key_facts: At the lighthouse, speak to the keeper, use easy catches to fund a sharpened early melee weapon, and complete his beer request. Give him the beer so the Empty Beer Can becomes available as the Spider Crab trigger. Summon the crab only after preparing, dodge its charge, attack during the short recovery, then pick up its distinct remains and return them to the keeper. The reward is boat access; obtain the radar before navigating onward.

primary_intent: Follow the main How to Fish quest chain in progression order
source_title: Complete How to Fish game walkthrough
supported_key_facts: The main route is Lighthouse → forest island → desert island → rock island → volcano. Each stage follows the same dependency: accept the local request, obtain or prepare the special bait, defeat the required creature, preserve its trophy, and finish the NPC hand-in to receive the next coordinates or vehicle access. The ending continues after the final kill, so return the last drop to the scientist and use the resulting boat key.
